rationale: On invented synthetic data the original S1.ground prompt generated a MAX_TOKENS loop at 2048 and at a diagnostic 3584 tokens; the archived 2048 output repeated the same 24-character sequence 273 times and compressed to 5.9% of original size. A distinct concise grounding prompt with the full provider JSON schema produced a locally valid CLARIFY task using 191 output tokens. Prompt effects require complete multi-turn and broader validation before acceptance.
modification: Apply the exact same concise, nonrepeating task grounding prompt to both systems. Omit the redundant inline copy of the task JSON format because the provider enforces the stage-specific responseJsonSchema; retain the strict local task validator. The S1.goal separate inference and stage_context intended_goal remain unchanged.
fairness_note: This candidate deliberately uses an identical grounding prompt for S0 and S1 so goal conditioning—not a different grounding instruction—is the principal architectural contrast. Different system call counts and context visibility remain part of the defined intervention.
selection_policy: Evaluate the full registered invented S0/S1 two-answer smoke and offline regression suite. Do not select an amended protected result by retrying held-out cases. Keep all failed development attempts in the audit.
approval: Not an approved technical freeze, human review receipt, or protected execution authorization.
